changeSet.comment: Document that DataAccess is the only actively-used election type; TranslateDUL, RP, and DataSet are deprecated and retained only for historical elections.

setColumnRemarks.remarks: Only 'DataAccess' is created for new elections. 'TranslateDUL', 'RP', and 'DataSet' are deprecated legacy values kept for historical records only.
